item.subject: science
item.stem: Dev makes eight planet flashcards for a quiz: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune. He also has a Moon card and wonders whether any card is a star. A planet is a large, nearly spherical object that revolves around the Sun. He must order the eight planets by increasing distance from the Sun and split them into inner and outer groups.

options.text: Order: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune; inner: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars; outer: Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune.
Order: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune; inner: Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune; outer: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars.
The Moon card should be placed with the eight planets in the same ordered list.
Venus is a star, so its flashcard should leave the planet set.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.
